segments: Grow the artillery-shell plant with the full three-round Blue Water + KT-4/Masamune cycle, load the AA cannon, shoot down the cargo plane, and watch where the cog lands.

The artillery-shell plant is not just a Blue Water plant: water it and shoot it once with the KT-4 or Masamune each round for three rounds. If the finished pod does not contain the shell, repeat the plant cycle.
Plant a seed, water it with Blue Water and shoot it once with the KT-4 or Masamune each round for three rounds. Open the finished pod and collect the artillery shell if it spawned.
Take the shell to the large Anti-Aircraft gun and load it before the cargo plane makes its pass.
Fire the AA cannon when the plane is in position, then immediately watch the falling cog.
Possible landing area: outside the bunker.
Possible landing area: Green Water side.
Possible landing area: Blue Water side near the spider cage.
Go to the landing area you saw and pick up the cog before moving on to the elevator.
